newsitem.title: USA: SFX shares up on merger rumors - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: SFX shares up on merger rumors - WSJ.

text.p: Speculation that SFX Broadcasting will be the next company acquired in the industry's rapid consolidation may be responsible for the recent rise in the company's share price, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Monday's electronic edition, the paper said that though no negotiations are yet being conducted and it is not clear who might be willing to buy the company at its $75 per share asking price, industry experts say if a transaction occurs, it could hit $80 a share or more.
The risk for shareholders is that the price could fall below $45 per share if a takeover does not materialize, the paper said in Monday's Heard of the Street column.
The column says that in a recent analysts conference call, SFX Chairman Robert Sillerman confirmed he had held informal talks with potential acquirers.
The company's stock was up 2-1/8 at 61 Friday.
